articles.author: Zeo Energy Corp.
articles.headline: Zeo Energy Enters Cooperation Agreement with Ewyze to Develop Integrated Off-Grid Power and Data-Center Infrastructure
articles.summary: Zeo announces cooperation with Ewyze on integrated off-grid power and data-centre infrastructure. The proposed development platform and pipeline are plans, subject to financing and execution; they are not completed powered facilities or recognized project revenue.
